clue.text: Foremost of prizes, say, in golf club

indicators.note: foremost of asks for the leading letter of the word prizes

parts.note: to say something is to utter it

explanation.surface: A golfer's leading prize is apparently a piece of equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: A short-headed club used on the green for rolling the ball towards the hole.

clue.text: Setting up, help out guides initially

parts.note: to pitch in is to help out

indicators.note: initially asks for the leading letter of guides

explanation.surface: Guides help to set up camp.
explanation.definitionFit: Pitching a tent is erecting it, so a synonym of setting up.

clue.text: Farm vehicle reportedly followed over top of ridge

indicators.note: reportedly means the word for followed is taken as it would be heard

parts.note: to have tracked someone is to have followed them
O is the cricket abbreviation for over

indicators.note: top of asks for the first letter of ridge, the top in a down entry

explanation.surface: A farm vehicle was said to be trailed over a ridge.
explanation.definitionFit: The heavy motor vehicle that pulls ploughs and trailers on a farm.

clue.text: Cast agrees, get a seasonal gift

indicators.note: cast means thrown or shaped afresh, so the letters of agrees and get are rearranged

explanation.surface: A play's cast agree they will receive presents for the season.
explanation.definitionFit: A chocolate treat given as a present at a spring holiday.

clue.text: Branch cancelled filming session

parts.note: an event that is cancelled is off
a film or photo shoot is a session of filming

explanation.surface: A film company's branch has had its filming session called off.
explanation.definitionFit: A side growth or subsidiary group springing from a main stem or organisation.

clue.text: Understand editorial about extremely manly game

parts.note: to follow an argument is to understand it

indicators.note: extremely asks for the outermost letters of manly

parts.note: a leader is a newspaper's editorial article

explanation.surface: Grasping a newspaper piece about a very macho sport.
explanation.definitionFit: A children's game in which everyone copies whatever the front person does.

clue.text: Brisk, small trading place

parts.note: S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small
a mart is a market, a place for trading

explanation.surface: A small market is doing brisk business.
explanation.definitionFit: A smart pace is quick and lively, so brisk.

clue.text: Editor enthralled by remarkably pious king of Thebes

indicators.note: enthralled by means the editor is held captive inside the rearranged letters
remarkably signals that the letters of pious appear in an unusual order

explanation.surface: An editor is captivated by a remarkably devout Greek ruler.
explanation.walkthrough: PIOUS rearranged gives OIPUS, which holds ED.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek legend he solved the Sphinx's riddle and ruled that city.

clue.text: Rubbish written about husband's do

indicators.note: about means the word for rubbish goes around the husband letter

parts.note: trash means rubbish
H is the genealogical abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: Gossip has been written about a husband's party.
explanation.definitionFit: A do and a thrash are both informal British words for a lively party.

clue.text: Scholz, perhaps, giving support to praise heard for senior British minister

indicators.note: in a down entry the piece giving support sits beneath the other, so the German leader word comes second
heard means the word for praise is taken as it sounds when spoken

parts.note: to laud is to praise
Olaf Scholz was the German Chancellor, the head of government

explanation.surface: A German leader backing a laudatory tribute to a British minister.
explanation.definitionFit: The senior cabinet office in Britain that heads the judiciary and presides in the Lords.

clue.text: Fungal growth in amphibians, likewise lizards originally

parts.note: toads are amphibians
too means likewise or also

indicators.note: originally asks for the opening letter of lizards

explanation.surface: A naturalist spots fungus on frogs and lizards alike.
explanation.definitionFit: An umbrella-shaped mushroom, often poisonous, is a familiar fungal growth.

clue.text: Dread moving snake

indicators.note: moving tells us to shift the letters of Dread around into a new order

explanation.surface: A slithering snake inspires dread.
explanation.definitionFit: A common venomous European viper, so a kind of snake.

clue.text: Powerful chief, one who is easily angered

parts.note: hot can mean powerful or strong, as in hot favourite or hot stuff
a chief is the head of a group

explanation.surface: A mighty leader with a short fuse.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone impetuous and quick-tempered, liable to flare up.

clue.text: Sea creature, first in particular place, not large

indicators.note: in places the word for first inside the trimmed place word
not tells us to drop the letter for large from the place word

parts.note: a locus is a particular place or position
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
top means first, as in top of the class

explanation.surface: A sea creature claims first place in some spot, though not a big one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not large' removes the L from the place word before 'in' slots the word for first into it; 'first' looks like an instruction to take an initial letter but is a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: An eight-armed marine mollusc, a familiar sea creature.

clue.text: Regular returned collecting right bottle

indicators.note: collecting means the reversed word gathers the right letter inside it
returned asks for the word for regular to be read backwards

parts.note: even means regular or steady

explanation.surface: A regular customer brings back a bottle, collecting the deposit.
explanation.walkthrough: EVEN reversed gives NEVE, with R inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Bottle is British slang for courage, so a synonym for nerve in the daring sense.

clue.text: Sleeping rough in shelter? Not as much

parts.note: a home is a shelter or dwelling
less means not as much

explanation.surface: Is there less rough sleeping now that shelters exist?
explanation.definitionFit: People sleeping rough on the streets have no dwelling of their own.

clue.text: Film desperate partisans along it

indicators.note: desperate signals the letters of partisans along it are thrown into wild disorder

explanation.surface: A movie about guerrilla fighters desperately pushing on.
explanation.definitionFit: A 1972 Bertolucci drama starring Marlon Brando.

clue.text: I look up article on the comic opera

indicators.note: in a down entry up means the word for look is read from bottom to top

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or behold
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: I check up on a newspaper piece about the light opera.
explanation.definitionFit: A Gilbert and Sullivan operetta about fairies and peers.

clue.text: Line taken by bishop when villain invades land taken back

indicators.note: invades means the villain goes inside the reversed land word
taken back asks for the word land to be read in reverse

parts.note: Iago is the villain of Shakespeare's Othello

explanation.surface: A churchman's procession goes on as a villain invades reclaimed territory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bishop' suggests a clergyman, but in chess the bishop piece moves only along slanting lines across the board.
explanation.definitionFit: A chess bishop always moves along a slanting line across the board.

clue.text: See 16
Fight caused by group near at hand

parts.note: a set is a group of things or people
to as an adverb can mean near at hand or close by, as in a door pulled to

explanation.surface: A brawl breaks out because a gang is close by.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief argument or scrap, a minor fight.

clue.text: Pot of tea, at first, then drank a rum

indicators.note: at first asks for the opening letter of tea
rum means odd or strange, so the letters of drank and a are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone had a pot of tea, then downed some rum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pot' looks like a teapot but is the definition, a drinking vessel. DRANK A rearranged gives ANKARD.
explanation.definitionFit: A large drinking mug with a handle, often for beer, is a pot.

clue.text: Shopkeeper sounds more common

indicators.note: sounds means we take the word for more common as it is spoken

parts.note: grosser means coarser or more vulgar, hence more common

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper speaks rather vulgarly.
explanation.definitionFit: A trader who sells food and household goods in a shop.

clue.text: Swift sharp reply in letter I posted

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the run of words letter I posted

explanation.surface: A quick retort came back to a letter I sent.
explanation.definitionFit: A quick witty retort, originally a fencer's return thrust.

clue.text: Energy of southern squad

parts.note: a team is a squad

explanation.surface: A team from the south has plenty of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Vapour power, or vigour, as in running out of puff.

clue.text: One feels social worker, Anne, should be retired

parts.note: the ant lives in organised colonies, a social insect and a worker

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn or drawn back, so Anne is read backwards

parts.note: the name taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone thinks Anne, a social worker, ought to retire.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as a person who feels, but means a thing used for feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: An insect's feeler is the organ it touches and senses with.

clue.text: Worry about Victor's cut

indicators.note: about means the word for worry goes round the Victor letter

parts.note: care is worry or anxiety
Victor is V in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone frets over Victor's injury.
explanation.definitionFit: To slice meat or sculpt wood, a synonym of cut.

clue.text: We, with initial manoeuvring, remain hidden while preparing to attack

definitions.text: remain hidden while preparing to attack

indicators.note: manoeuvring means moving the letters of we and initial into new positions

explanation.surface: A military plan: our first manoeuvres are to stay hidden before striking.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for an ambush, staying concealed until the moment to strike.

clue.text: Herb and flower garden visited by scholar

indicators.note: visited by means the scholar goes inside the garden word

parts.note: a rosery is a rose garden
MA, a Master of Arts, is a scholar

explanation.surface: An academic drops in on a garden of herbs and blooms.
explanation.definitionFit: An aromatic culinary herb with needle-like leaves.

clue.text: Reserve rowing crew that is after best medal

indicators.note: after places the that-is abbreviation behind the medal word

parts.note: gold is the medal for first place
ie stands for id est, Latin for that is

explanation.surface: A rowing crew that is chasing the top prize.
explanation.walkthrough: The Cambridge University Boat Club's reserve crew races the Oxford reserves each spring.
explanation.definitionFit: The proper name of Cambridge's second-string boat in the annual university races.
